response.explanation: getClientsWithPermission calls resourceStore.findByType(server, "Clients", ...) and adds resource.getName() for every resource that evaluates to the scope. Real clients are not expanded: there is no code that lists the realm's clients when the type resource is granted. The only caller, AvailableRoleMappingResource.getRoleIdsWithPermissions (line 230), calls realm.getClientById(cid).getRolesStream() on each returned id. For "Clients", getClientById returns null, which causes a NullPointerException. If the all-clients permission is granted, the real clients that have no per-client resource are missing from the set. Because the interface Javadoc says all-clients permissions apply to all clients, the result under-reports.
